issues: No client-side validation enforcing preference_score hint or block format — backend default of 50 is silently applied which is fine but not surfaced in UI.

Route /phase1-complete itself is not protected; only sidebar entry is hidden for non-admin roles. Student-role users hitting URL directly can see the page (reads succeed, writes 403). Acceptable per spec but consider adding a phase1-not-allowed guard for cleaner UX.

critical_code_review_comments: routes_phase1_complete.py — All 25 endpoints tenant-isolated, audit-logged, with proper role guards on write paths (notices, hostel, iqac-meetings, company-intel reject student role with 403). Cross-tenant 403 enforced consistently.

Phase1Complete.jsx — Uses generic MiniForm/Panel/ItemList/Kpi/MiniBar/FormCard helpers keeping 458-line file readable and DRY across all 6 tab consoles. Audience field is plain text input not a Select — accepts free text 'student|faculty|parent|admin'. Backend validates via 422 on invalid audience (test_alert_audience_rejects_invalid passes).

Phase1Complete.jsx — Each tab independently fetches its data in useEffect. The 'react-hooks/exhaustive-deps' eslint warning around refresh in useEffect is consistent with the rest of the codebase per main-agent note, no runtime bug.

Sidebar.jsx — phase1-complete entry correctly gated to institution_admin/dean role tier; student tier sidebar verified as not rendering the testid (count=0). Route in App.js is not wrapped in role guard but the page degrades gracefully (reads succeed, writes 403 server-side).

rca of the issue: No issues found.
